why: Wrong register and wrong sense in the second half. служебная командировка is a civilian business trip — a fixed collocation from HR and accounting (оформить служебную командировку, командировочные расходы). The gloss is "the sending of troops to a place where they are needed" and all three examples are the tour-of-duty sense ("his third deployment overseas", "the deployment was extended by six months", "long deployments are hard on families"). A Russian reader would picture a two-day office trip instead of a combat tour; боевая командировка is the term Russian actually uses for that.
